name: Recovery labels
decision: Retain as a conditional empirical study
support: Product-graph counterexamples and isolated native teacher inspection establish a possible distinction; natural prevalence unmeasured.
remaining_objections: Language-aligned waypoint and reward-machine baselines may explain the entire gain; alternative routes and ambiguous obligations can invalidate labels.
novelty_confidence: Low for a new mechanism; low-to-moderate for the narrowed empirical contribution within the bounded search.
logical_status: Corrected static oracle under explicit physical/event/menu/STOP assumptions; no learned compliance guarantee.
empirical_status: Toy graph and isolated source checks only; no natural audit or navigation training.
feasibility: First audit needs visual traces, checkpoint/preprocessing and annotations; graph-only toy checks are already feasible.
scientific_value: Potential recovery-label resource and controlled evidence about supervision; a null result can reject an unsupported premise.
next_decisive_experiment: Blinded full-continuation audit on natural checkpoints, with separate controlled histories and LAW/RM/efficiency controls.

name: Route validity
decision: Retain as a conditional empirical study
support: Paper/source evidence distinguishes navigator-relative filtering from independently supported route-language validity.
remaining_objections: CVS and ordinary grounding verifiers may match the result; extra annotation, missing labels and pool composition confound gains.
novelty_confidence: Low for validity-plus-hardness; low-to-moderate for a route-witness audit and matched empirical result.
logical_status: Feasible disjoint-stratum selector is elementary; complete witness bundles do not certify truth; no population calibration assumed.
empirical_status: No candidate-pool annotation, selector training or navigation experiment.
feasibility: Needs immutable generated pool, route observations, frozen difficulty scores and independent annotation.
scientific_value: Potential evidence taxonomy and quality/competence separation at fixed data and human effort.
next_decisive_experiment: Probability-sampled validity/witness audit, comparing equal acceptance and annotation effort against CVS/compatibility/alignment controls.

name: Negative memory
decision: Retain as a conditional contamination study
support: Actual isolated source functions demonstrate a conditional negative-write, veto and spatial-exclusion pathway.
remaining_objections: Natural harm may be rare; freeze/quarantine may suffice; release differs from paper EEC; deployable causes may be unidentifiable.
novelty_confidence: Low for diagnosis before memory; uncertain residual claim-specific empirical distinction after HiMeco, EmbodiSkill and DoCtOR.
logical_status: Failure alone is non-identifying; masked losses and correlated gates require separate empirical validation.
empirical_status: Synthetic conditional source example only; no real harmful-write rate or repeated-navigation result.
feasibility: Begin with shadow logs and fixed-feature replay; full PSG server and simulator require additional assets/resources.
scientific_value: Potential evidence about semantic contamination and a narrowly controlled write-policy intervention.
next_decisive_experiment: Natural failure/write replay against no-write, quarantine, simple controller rules and witness-only controls, with retrieval held fixed.

name: Joint future events
decision: Reject as an original-method proposal; retain diagnostic only
support: Matched timewise and ever-event marginals can differ in ordered joint events under the constructed feature map.
remaining_objections: Ordered-event prediction is directly expressible as a monitor-conditioned generalized value function; actual target collisions and learnability unknown.
novelty_confidence: High confidence in broad prior-art collision; no original-method claim retained.
logical_status: Symbolic aliasing example and finite-horizon GVF reduction are scoped and valid; no sufficient representation or risk guarantee.
empirical_status: Symbolic checks only; no trained predictor or navigation test.
feasibility: Defer training and route-task port unless a distinct cost/learnability result is established.
scientific_value: Optional representation audit, not a recommended fourth method project.
next_decisive_experiment: If pursued separately, compare matched GVF/PSR, sequence, future-QA and distributional controls before any method claim.
